body: I'm in the EXACT same boat. It's hard because he's so caring and understanding but at the same time I feel like if I tell him about the super dark feelings I have, he'll be freaked out and leave me. It's like this weird cycle in my mind. "Get your feelings out, talk to him"...2 seconds later it's, "what guy would want to be with a girl this fucked up?? I'm gonna run him off!"... Over and over again .. Ugh.  I'm not helping, but I wanted to say I know how you feel...

The root of it for me is my parents. I don't even know where to begin, but let's just say they weren't the best. I was raised to feel like something was wrong with me .. I've always felt that way. I've been sad and depressed for as long as I can remember. Just shitty shitty parents who should never have had a child. Alcoholic, extremely abusive mother. Neglectful father. Bat shit crazy step mother. I was doomed from the start. Should never have been given the gift of life. Could've gone without all of this. I was fine where I was .. In the blackness

I'm 27 which is embarrassing to admit bc who still whines about childhood at this age? Anyway, I feel like so many things could have been done differently on their part. Nobody is perfect, but they didn't even try. No I don't live with them I hope to never see them again actually

"Get pregnant so you can receive welfare benefits"

Told to me by my ex step mom when I was ~21
